beta-technologies.description: Architected BETA's public web platform as a Go and TypeScript service backed by PostgreSQL, containerized on AWS ECS, and delivered through CI/CD. Established site-wide event instrumentation and improved Lighthouse performance, creating a measurable foundation for adoption and conversion analysis.

bilte-co.description: As sole engineer on a two-person team, delivered an integrated flight-operations insights platform in three months on a five-figure budget. A Go and MQTT ingestion pipeline loaded millions of aircraft and ground-vehicle telemetry points into PostgreSQL and ClickHouse in minutes, revealing previously invisible over-resourcing and utilization gaps. The proof of concept validated the business case for later enterprise-scale investment.
Designed and optimized infrastructure for ingesting, indexing, searching, and monitoring hundreds of millions of genealogical artifacts per day, supporting enterprise contracts valued at $500K–$3M.

Designed a curated research-data platform with Yale neuroscientists, replacing manual workflows and normalizing decades of genomic records. The system surfaced relationships across datasets, reduced recurring data-entry errors, and supported analysis and peer-reviewed publication.

Served as fractional CTO for an ESG data startup, hiring and leading a senior engineering team while guiding product architecture and delivery. Built public data products and reporting tools that helped achieve top-five organic Google rankings for key brand-sustainability queries.

Modernized personalization and measurement flows across NetApp's global web properties. The resulting campaigns delivered conversion rates roughly 3× the control rate while requiring an estimated 90–95% less engineering effort to implement.
